arms.P0_ORACLE: true generating source (synthetic worlds only). On W4/W5 recorded as CANNOT_CHECK_ORACLE_ABSENT_REAL_CORPUS.
arms.P1_NGRAM_WB_D8: interpolated n-gram, Witten-Bell lambda = n(ctx)/(n(ctx)+d(ctx)), frozen max order 8, deterministic backoff to shorter context, add-1/2 at unigram base against alphabet+1
arms.P2_PPM_C_O8: PPM with escape method C, max order 8, NO exclusion (declared conservative); escape mass over unseen symbols divided uniformly over symbols unseen at that order
arms.P3_CTW_KT_D12: exact Context Tree Weighting, Krichevsky-Trofimov / Dirichlet(1/2,...,1/2) per-context estimator, mixture weight 1/2 estimated : 1/2 children-product, context depth 12, log-domain, lazy child creation, unseen-subtree weight 1
arms.P4_WFA_EM: weighted finite automaton = hidden-Markov model, k=8 states, seeded row-normalised init from Random(2140354), 10 Baum-Welch iterations CAP with deterministic early stop at relative LL gain < 1e-6, frozen at eval (batch arm). SCOPE (pre-run amendment A2, pure-Python compute feasibility, decided before any scored run): W1/W2/W3 at n=16000 only and W5 at n=20000 only; every other ladder step and W4 recorded CANNOT_CHECK_COMPUTE_BUDGET. The spectral (Hankel/SVD) variant is recorded CANNOT_CHECK_NO_STDLIB_SVD; EM-HMM is the declared bounded substitute parent.
arms.P5_PCFG_EM: PCFG induction inside a frozen budget: hand-authored rule TEMPLATE (declared and charged as prior information), probabilities by inside-outside EM, 60 iterations CAP with the same deterministic early stop, EM fit over the most recent 1500 depth-0 blocks (pre-run amendment A3: declared fit subsample, charged). W2 template in chart form: S->a T, T->S b, S->c plus distractors S->S S, S->b W, W->S a, S->a S, S->b S (EM must push distractors down). DECLARED INFORMATION GIFT, charged in results: on W2 (which has no surface sentence boundaries) the PCFG arm receives the stream pre-segmented into constituent blocks at depth-0 boundaries, for BOTH fitting and scoring; all other arms see the raw stream. Per-symbol prediction uses Earley-style prefix probabilities (Stolcke 1995) with a deterministic relaxation tolerance 1e-12 capped at 50 sweeps, so the chain rule P(x_t|x_<t) is exact up to that declared tolerance. SCOPE: W2 (main + expressivity dial); every other world CANNOT_CHECK_OUT_OF_DECLARED_SCOPE.
arms.P6_BPE_PPM: byte-pair segmentation with a frozen budget of 200 merges + PPM order 4 over unit ids. W4: merges learned over whitespace-delimited word types weighted by frequency (the original BPE setting; word boundary is real surface structure, not an answer). W3: merges learned on the raw character burn-in slice (no boundary given). Merge-learning work is charged in full. SCOPE: W3 and W4; elsewhere CANNOT_CHECK_OUT_OF_DECLATED_SCOPE.
arms.P7_KNN_SEQ: case-based sequence memory: window h=6, bucket index on the window's first 3 symbols (first 2 on W4 where alphabet is large), scan at most the 8000 most recent same-bucket windows, k=8 nearest by Hamming distance, distance-weighted vote. Index build and every window comparison charged. Scored on a deterministic stride-8 subsample of the protected tail (declared; accuracy estimated on subsample).
arms.P8_LOGISTIC_DIAG: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, NO ADOPTION AUTHORITY: single-layer softmax over one-hot last-4 symbols, SGD 5 epochs, fixed learning rate 0.05, seeded init Random(2140358). SCOPE: W1/W2/W3 and W5; W4 CANNOT_CHECK_COMPUTE_BUDGET.

controls.hand_authored_prior_charge: P5's rule template is hand-authored prior information: 6 rules (W2) / (3 + |tags|) rules (W5) with free probability vectors, counted in the results and the protocol.
controls.no_free_preprocessing: every per-arm preparation is charged inside that arm's work counters: P5 grammar-template EM, P6 merge induction, P3 tree storage, P7 index build, P4/P8 full retrain on each ladder step.
controls.protected_split_disjointness: the scored region of every world is disjoint from every burn-in ladder position; on W4/W5 additionally the test FILE is sha256-gated and opened only by the frozen evaluator path.
controls.shuffle_null: at the largest n per world, the burn-in region is permuted by a fixed Random(2140360) permutation (marginals preserved, temporal structure destroyed) and the affected arms re-scored on the SAME protected tail. Registered null direction: every parent whose gain comes from temporal structure must degrade toward the unigram floor; an arm that keeps its score under a shuffled burn-in fails the causal gate for this function.

pre_run_amendments.change: Depth-first recursion law: after 'a' the innermost S decides a/c; after 'c' or 'b' the stack unwinds with deterministic 'b' until depth 0; at depth 0 a fresh S decides a/c; at the depth cap termination 'c' is forced. Every depth-0 block is exactly a^k c b^k (k <= D_MAX). Oracle conditions on exact pending depth (max suffix-sum) + phase (deciding/unwinding/cap) and reproduces the generator empirically (worst |empirical-oracle| = 0.0057 at n=20000, sampling noise).

protocol.accuracy: top-1 exact-symbol prediction over the same scored region, computed on the declared uniform stride-8 subsample of that region for EVERY arm including the oracle (pre-run amendment A1: uniform across arms, cost-driven, decided before any scored run); for P7 the loss subsample and the accuracy subsample coincide (stride 8).
protocol.budget_cap: whole suite wall clock <= 7200 s on the execution host (pre-run amendment A4, raised from 3600 s after sizing the pure-Python 3.8 implementation; decided before any scored run); any arm exceeding its declared scope is recorded CANNOT_CHECK_<reason>, never silently dropped.
protocol.constituent_block_gift: W2 only: P5 sees depth-0 constituent blocks (fit + score); charged as declared extra information in every comparison involving P5.
protocol.data_efficiency: samples-to-threshold = smallest ladder n with scored bits/symbol <= oracle + 0.05 (synthetic worlds). On W4/W5 the reference is the strongest parent in the suite, declared as such.
protocol.lifecycle_cost: train_wall_seconds, work counters (declared elementary operations per arm), persistent bytes = len of canonical compact JSON serialisation of fitted state, update work per scored symbol, refit cost for batch arms.
protocol.primary: prequential: predict x_t from x_<t then update, for online arms P1/P2/P3/P7 and the P6 unit model. Batch arms (P4/P5/P8, P6 merges) fit on burn-in [0,n) then frozen during the scored region; the protocol difference is inherent to the parent class and is itself reported.
protocol.revocation: retract the last 256 burn-in symbols: count-based online arms must restore exactly (state digest equality asserted); batch arms pay a full refit, timed. Ratio reported.
protocol.scored_region: protected tail T of each world (see worlds); per-symbol log-loss = -log2(max(p, floor)) with eps_floor = 2^-20 applied identically to every arm; unseen-symbol rate reported per world.

registered_predictions_before_execution.R1: On W1_PSA, P3 CTW is within 0.02 bits/symbol of P0 by n=16000; P1 n-gram-D8 is not within 0.02 until n=64000.
registered_predictions_before_execution.R2: On W2_NESTED at D_MAX=48, every finite-context arm (P1,P2,P3) is at least 0.10 bits/symbol worse than P0; P5 recovers to within 0.05 of P0 if EM finds the true rule weights.
registered_predictions_before_execution.R3: On W3_LEXICON, P6 BPE+PPM beats char-level P2 at n=64000 in bits/symbol after merge induction is charged.
registered_predictions_before_execution.R4: On W5_UD_POS, the strongest online non-neural parent (expected P3) is not worse than the P8 logistic diagnostic in bits/symbol (parent sufficiency at registered scope).
registered_predictions_before_execution.R5: Under the shuffle null at max n, every arm degrades by at least 0.05 bits/symbol on every world where it beat the unigram floor.

work_package: FNA-3 (deliverable FNA-D5) — non-neural sequence / language learning

W1_PSA.generator: variable-order Markov source (probabilistic suffix automaton) over alphabet [a,b,c]; frozen sparse context table, max context depth 3, table burned in before use
W1_PSA.oracle: the generating table itself (exact next-symbol distribution)
W1_PSA.stream: 84000 symbols: burn-in ladder n in [1000,4000,16000,64000] then T=20000 protected scored tail (positions n..n+20000)

W2_NESTED.generator: stochastic nesting grammar S -> a S b with prob 0.72, S -> c with prob 0.28; nesting depth truncated at D_MAX=48; alphabet [a,b,c]
W2_NESTED.oracle: the generating grammar with exact stack depth (exact next-symbol distribution)
W2_NESTED.stream: 84000 symbols: same ladder and T=20000 tail as W1

W3_LEXICON.generator: 24 multi-character words (length 2-5, drawn from a frozen seeded generator with shared internal character structure), word occurrence Zipf-distributed, word order order-1 Markov over word ids, word internals deterministic given id; character stream
W3_LEXICON.oracle: the word-level Markov chain mapped through the word table (exact next-character distribution)
W3_LEXICON.stream: 84000 characters: same ladder and T=20000 tail

W4_UD_CHAR.oracle: ABSENT (real corpus has no generative oracle)
W4_UD_CHAR.source: UD_English-EWT r2.14, sha256-gated by the frozen custody manifest
W4_UD_CHAR.stream: sentence texts joined by single newline, character level; train slice = first 1000000 chars of the train split; scored protected tail = first 100000 chars of the PROTECTED test split; burn-in ladder n in [50000,200000,1000000]

W5_UD_POS.oracle: ABSENT (real corpus has no generative oracle)
W5_UD_POS.stream: UPOS tag per token, sentences joined by boundary symbol '_', stream over tags; burn-in ladder n in [20000,80000,254000] tags (largest = whole train split); scored protected tail = the ENTIRE test split stream
